name: Hannah Brewster

relationships.evidence: Thompson: daughter of Rev. Nathaniel Brewster; her mother a daughter of Roger Ludlow

bioAdditions: B. F. Thompson's family account (S1) gives her dates (b. 19 May 1679, d. 7 Nov 1755), her first marriage to John Muncy (16 Jan 1703; he d. 12 Jun 1707) and her second to Samuel Thompson (6 Nov 1709), and says she and Samuel are buried at the south-east corner of the Setauket Presbyterian Church. She was the mother of Susannah Thompson Strong and grandmother of Selah Strong. Not John's ancestor.

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296
